title: Map one record to another
hints: `str(Decimal(cents) / 100)` can give `19.99`, but `Decimal(cents).scaleb(-2).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))` always gives two places (lesson 5.02).
`order["placed"][:10]` is the date part of an ISO time stamp.
requirements: `to_invoice(order)` builds the new shape; money becomes a string with two decimals (use `Decimal`).
A missing email raises `ValueError` with the order id.
Keep the field names in one mapping, not spread through the code.
stretch: Write the reverse mapping and check that a round trip gives the same order.
